messages.author: 115eb58ac20e3528
messages.subject: Plotting tip labels
parts:
Dear Dr Yu,
Is it possible to print two columns of tip labels using geom_tiplab()? I have tried several possibilities and nothing seems to work.

For example, I would like the first set of tip labels to be the species name, followed by a second set that contains the family name for each species.

If you could just give me a general suggestion as to where to start, that would be helpful. I cannot find any example where two layers of geom_tiplab are used in the same plot.

Best,
Dave
